== Summary ==
All 40 pages of '''''The Rules''''', the ''Star Wars Customizable Card Game'' rulebook packed in [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] starter decks (© 1995 Decipher Inc.; printed in Belgium by Carta Mundi), in page order at printed size (about 6.3 × 8.7 cm per page). Document page: [[Premiere starter deck rulebook]].

Source: the 20 two-page 600 dpi TIFF spreads in the folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Rulebook (from Premiere Starter Deck)] of the public "SWCCG Scans" Google Drive folder (owner not shown), uploaded to Google Drive in April 2024 (file dates 21 April 2024). Preserved copy of the folder: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261112195026/https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Internet Archive]. Each spread was cut at the spine and each page stored as a 600 dpi JPEG (quality 92); the lossless page images are the PNG files listed on the document page.

Used on [[Premiere starter deck rulebook]] and [[Rulebooks]].
